name: Raspberry Pi Pico (BLOCKS seat)
note: Pads and pin names parse at load from pico.kicad_mod and pico.kicad_sym, byte copies of the KiCad library Module.pretty/RaspberryPi_Pico_Common_THT.kicad_mod (gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints at f8440fa61a5690b48b325c891fdb99c0038a5a59, 2026-10-10) and MCU_Module.kicad_symdir/RaspberryPi_Pico.kicad_sym (gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-symbols at 9280a937942c74c7d6fd5148a2d49ee7d87773d1, 2026-10-15), fetched with tools/py/board/kicad_fetch.py. KiCad libraries are CC-BY-SA 4.0 with the KiCad design exception; KiCad's LICENSE.md sits beside them (tools/licences.json). n is the vendor pin number (1 to 20 down the left column, 21 to 40 up the right, USB at top); names are the KiCad symbol's (GPIO0, GPIO26_ADC0, AGND), which the BLOCKS seat calls GP0, GP26 and GND. The frame is the pad bounding box centre (origin pads-centre), +y toward the USB end. The GND pads are custom pads in the footprint; the catalog reads them as their 1.6 mm circle anchor.
